_note: Player card catalog (tools/card_catalog.py, baked by build_cards.py). Structure from trac3r's cosmetics.ts/achievements.ts; see PLAN.md 'Player cards, progression and ranked'.

levels._note: XP to go from level L to L+1 = xp_base + xp_step * (L - 1)

stats_doc.wins_mode.<mode>: wins per game mode (ffa, duel, tdm, ctf, ca, ft, instagib)
stats_doc.matches_skin.<model>/<skin>: matches played in each skin (red/blue for team skins)
stats_doc.frags_weapon.<weapon>: frags per weapon (gauntlet, machinegun, shotgun, grenade, rocket, lightning, railgun, plasma, bfg)
stats_doc.medal.<award>: Quake 3 awards: excellent, impressive, gauntlet, capture, assist, defend, perfect
stats_doc.pickups.<item>: item pickups (quad, regen, haste, battlesuit, invis, flight, mega, armor_red, armor_yellow, medkit, teleporter)
stats_doc.deaths_by.<cause>: deaths by lava, slime, fall, drown, telefrag, crush
stats_doc.air_rocket_frags: rocket frags while airborne after a rocket jump
stats_doc.ca_clutches: Clan Arena rounds won as the last one standing
stats_doc.flawless_ffa: Free For All wins with no deaths
stats_doc.trifectas: matches with an Excellent, an Impressive and a Gauntlet
stats_doc.best.rail_streak: most rail hits in a row
stats_doc.best.rail_accuracy: best railgun accuracy in a match (%, 10+ shots)
stats_doc.ranked_rating: current ranked rating (MMR, set by official ranked servers)
